Summary: The SPR draw is DISCRETIONARY - a ~172M bbl emergency authorization in response to Hormuz, the alarming half of my own dichotomy. Mechanism: EXCHANGE via DOE RFPs; volume over 170 million barrels (reported 172M); trigger the Iran conflict/Hormuz restrictions; authorized March 2026 by the President (reported); delivery window primarily April-August 2026; repayment late-2026 to 2029 at an 18-24% premium in kind; SPR ~415M in March vs 298.694M at wk-8/7, ~116M drawn since. THE SAME ANSWER BREAKS MY OWN SEC-3: the -6.04M bbl/week is NOT a crisis run-rate that could continue, it is a scheduled delivery programme running to a calendar whose window ends this month, and the twelve consecutive draws with no build - which I presented as relentless consumption - are exactly what a contracted delivery schedule looks like. AND THE BARRELS ARE NOT GONE, THEY ARE LENT: repayment at a premium in kind means the SPR ends with MORE barrels than it started. DIRECTION: the 298.694M level HOLDS; the 1982-83-fill finding HOLDS and my correction of the WSJ's 'since 1982' is independently corroborated by a Fox Business headline in this same sweep; the arithmetic HOLDS; the 'spent hard right now' framing WEAKENS MATERIALLY; the '~49 weeks' figure is WITHDRAWN - I labelled it arithmetic-not-a-forecast, which was the right label on a number that should not have been offered at all because its only use IS extrapolation; and the TWO-BUFFERS synthesis WEAKENS and is the one to re-read, because spare production capacity at ~0.02 mb/d is STRUCTURAL and cannot be scheduled back while the SPR trough is CYCLICAL AND CONTRACTED with repayment terms - they are not the same object and treating them as equivalent overstated the case. Nothing in -007 is factually wrong; its FRAMING was more alarming than the mechanism supports, and this correction runs AGAINST my own prior. WHAT IS GENUINELY ALARMING IS A NUMBER NOBODY HAS MENTIONED - the 18-24% premium: participants take barrels now and repay 1.18-1.24 barrels later, an extraordinary price for immediacy and a market-derived stress read no spread or spot print in this fleet captures. Stated as observation not conclusion - an exchange premium is negotiated and set against a term schedule so it is NOT a spot backwardation; the source frames it as DOE leveraging market backwardation to rebuild inventories beyond mandated baselines, on which reading it is a competent trade rather than a distress signal. Both live, BRENT owns which. THE DOE'S OWN RELEASE HISTORY HAS NO 2026 ENTRY - energy.gov history-spr-releases was FETCHED SUCCESSFULLY and its most recent record is a 2025 ExxonMobil exchange, no 2026 record at all, on the page whose purpose is to record SPR releases, during the largest drawdown since 2022.
